title: Vampire Vape Purple Craze Ice Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape’s Purple Craze Ice Flavour Concentrate delivers an intensified version of the original Purple Craze, combining the same irresistible mix of fresh Fruits, tangy Berries, and subtle Aniseed spice, but with a more pronounced, icy Menthol finish. This concentrate offers DIY e-liquid mixers the chance to craft their own cool, refreshing vape juice with flavours inspired by the legendary Heisenberg and Pinkman blends. This 30ml concentrate is ideal for DIY vapers who want full control over their e-liquid’s flavour and nicotine levels, with the added benefit of a bold, cooling exhale from the extra Menthol. Simply add this 100% PG-based concentrate to your preferred VG/PG mix to create your custom vape juice. The recommended dilution rates are between 15-20%, depending on your flavour strength preferences. Produced in the UK to the highest quality standards, Vampire Vape concentrates are known for their rich, authentic flavours. Explore the wider range of Vampire Vape flavour concentrates, including fan-favourites like Heisenberg and Pinkman, for even more DIY mixing possibilities. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is for mixing your own e-liquid and is not suitable for direct vaping or commercial use.
